newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open mixed, look to data for direction.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open mixed, look to data for direction.

text.p: UK shares opened mixed on Wednesday as another bout of profit-taking in New York weighed on London in early trading, dealers said.
A scarcity of company news deprived investors of direction at the start and the market was expected to continue to drift ahead of UK retail sales data at 0830 GMT.
UK markets have already discounted a small monthly fall in retail activity with retail sales forecast to dip 0.1 percent after a 1.0 percent rise in August.
Shortly after the start the FTSE 100 was up just 2.3 points at 4,059.5 with decliners leading advancers by two to one.
